newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Elektrowatt open from small acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Elektrowatt open from small acquisitions.

text.p: Elektrowatt AG Chief Executive Oskar Ronner said the group saw no need for any more major acquisitions but could make some smaller additions before it is taken over as planned by Germany's Siemens AG.
"We do not need any major acquisitions any more, at most smaller regional ones to round off existing activities," Ronner an annual news conference.
Ronner said one area with an interest in buying complimentary businesses was security systems division Cerberus, mainly in the Americas and Asia-Pacific region.

Elektrowatt is due to split into two divisions later this year and be sold to separate groups by major stockholder Credit Suisse Group, with its industrial business going to Siemens and power business to a German-Swiss consortium.
